_comment: Machine-readable summary of the autonomous verification pass.
Rules this file obeys: a check is 'passed' only when a command actually ran and returned
success. Anything that could not run is 'notRun' with a reason, never 'passed'. No value here

releaseSigning.reason: No release keystore in this environment

releaseApkOnDevice.reason: R8 output was never installed or exercised

defectsFoundAndFixed.summary: Caller-supplied GCM IV rejected by Keystore; vault creation failed on every real device
Backup format v1 produced permanently unrestorable items; fixed by v2 re-keying
Backup loaded whole containers into memory
HOME component shipped enabled, forcing a launcher chooser on every user
Biometric enrolment failed silently (StrongBox on auth-bound key)
Infinite ticker in UnlockViewModel hung the unit suite and woke every second in normal use
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and WAKE_LOCK merged in from media3; removed
Instrumented suite depended on test order via persistent DataStore state
Modules without instrumented tests built empty test APKs that crashed

blockers.summary: core.crypto.keystore at 1% coverage, no instrumented tests
SecureImportEngine at 2% coverage; Secure Move ordering untested end to end
Modern mode (API 35+) has never executed; no system image installed
minSdk 26 has never executed; no system image installed
No physical device: StrongBox, biometric invalidation, MediaStore delete untested
Release APK never installed or exercised
Legal and privacy layer incomplete; placeholders unresolved

notRun.reason: No gcloud, project, credentials or billing
Not performed; no-network claim is static evidence only

notRun.item: Macrobenchmark / cold start / jank / throughput / battery

legalAndPrivacy._note: optionalConsentVerified is true because the app contains no analytics or crash-reporting SDK, so there is nothing to consent to and the optional-consent screen is deliberately not shown. inAppAccessPresent is false because the acceptance flow is built but not yet wired into app navigation.

honesty.statement: Every result recorded here came from a command that ran. Items that could not run are marked notRun with a reason.
